title: Apex Logistics vs. Meridian Rail Corp (Antitrust Settlement Brief)

pages.content: UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT. CASE NO: 23-CV-8891. IN RE: MERIDIAN RAIL ACQUISITION LITIGATION. Preliminary Statement: Plaintiffs allege anticompetitive exclusive dealing agreements in rail freight corridors across the Midwest territory between 2019 and 2022.

SECTION 4: MARKET DEFINITION & HHI THRESHOLDS. The relevant product market is defined strictly as heavy freight intermodal transportation. Pre-merger Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI) was calculated at 2,450. Post-transaction HHI exceeds 3,100, establishing a prima facie presumption of enhanced market power under DOJ/FTC Horizontal Merger Guidelines Section 5.3.

SECTION 9.4: MONETARY SETTLEMENT & DIVESTITURE REMEDY. Meridian Rail agreed to pay a total settlement fund of $42,500,000 into escrow within thirty (30) calendar days of preliminary court approval. Furthermore, Meridian must divest twelve (12) regional spur line rights-of-way to an independent certified rail operator approved by the Special Master.

SECTION 14: NON-DISCLOSURE AND EXCLUSIVITY CARVEOUTS. Counsel fees shall not exceed twenty-two percent (22%) of the common benefit fund, capped at $9,350,000. All confidential commercial pricing matrices submitted under seal shall remain protected under the Protective Order for a mandatory period of ten (10) years.

title: Vanguard Technologies vs. Dr. Emily Thorne (Restrictive Covenant Ruling)

pages.content: IN THE APPELLATE DIVISION. In the matter of enforceability of Section 11 Non-Competition Clause. Dr. Thorne was employed as Chief AI Architect. The agreement stipulated a worldwide 24-month restriction from working with any competitive artificial intelligence venture.

HOLDING ON GEOGRAPHIC SCOPE: The appellate court holds that a worldwide geographic restriction without limitation to specific commercial customers or active accounts is unenforceable under state common law as an unreasonable restraint of trade. A non-compete covenant exceeding 12 months in fast-moving technology sectors is presumed unreasonable unless accompanied by garden leave compensation.

REMEDY & BLUE-PENCILLING: The trial court's decision to blue-pencil the covenant from 24 months down to 6 months within a 50-mile radius is AFFIRMED. Vanguard Tech's petition for injunctive preliminary relief is DENIED.

title: BioHealth Inc. vs. Genovate Pharmaceuticals (Patent Royalty Dispute)

pages.content: US PATENT NO. 9,842,104: Formulation for mRNA lipid nanoparticle encapsulation. Article 3 stipulates a running royalty rate of 4.75% on Net Global Commercial Sales of therapeutic batches manufactured using the licensed protocol.

AUDIT CLAUSE & UNDERREPORTING PENALTY: Licensor maintains the right upon thirty (30) days prior written notice to conduct an independent inspection of licensee manufacturing logs. In the event an underpayment exceeding five percent (5%) of royalties owed is detected, Genovate must pay interest accrued at prime rate + 3%, plus 100% of reasonable audit costs incurred.
